title: Remote viewing a hidden power that pushes for one world government to prepare humanity for space

tellings.quote: the powers that actually are behind the governments and run the governments uh want us to have one world, one government to prepare us for space.

plain: Behind the world's governments, the claim goes, sit hidden powers that actually run them and want one world under one government, to get humanity ready for space. A former Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan, who did remote viewing, the practice of trying to perceive distant or hidden things with the mind alone, tells Michels this is what he came to see. If true, it would mean world politics is being steered toward contact beyond Earth.
